modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture exact bytes and tool timestamps, decode with checked arithmetic, validate epoch range/rollover/time basis and compare an approved reference within stated tolerance without writing clocks.

independent_technical_reasoning: The command yields a fixed four-byte value, so length, unsigned little-endian conversion, range and optional skew are deterministic; therefore the case is FULLY AUTOMATABLE after time-policy input.
